5637



                           NEW YORK STATE SENATE





                          THE STENOGRAPHIC RECORD









                             ALBANY, NEW YORK

                              August 9, 2004

                                 3:30 p.m.





                              REGULAR SESSION







            SENATOR PATRICIA K. McGEE, Acting President

            STEVEN M. BOGGESS, Secretary















                                                        5638



                           P R O C E E D I N G S

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    The

                 Senate will come to order.

                            I ask everyone present to please

                 rise and repeat with me the Pledge of

                 Allegiance.

                            (Whereupon, the assemblage recited

                 the Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag.)

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    The

                 invocation today will be given by the Reverend

                 Peter G. Young, of Blessed Sacrament Church in

                 Bolton Landing.

                            REVEREND YOUNG:    Thank you,

                 Senator.

                            Let us pray.

                            As we enjoy our summer vacation

                 time, we have found the time to return to our

                 Senate and state priorities and concerns of

                 government.

                            O, God, You have called us to

                 assist the needy and provide positive

                 leadership for all of our New York State

                 citizens.  You have dedicated Senators here

                 who have been dedicated to respond to their

                 legislative responsibilities, that will



                                                        5639



                 provide and promote the positive agenda for

                 all of our New York State constituents.

                            We ask You, O, Lord, to bless their

                 efforts and the time, and to give them the

                 strength and the energy to continue this good

                 work.  Their presence here in this session

                 confirms their commitment and priority to use

                 their skills and talents for You that You have

                 blessed them with, and for all of the people

                 of our state.

                            Amen.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    Reading

                 of the Journal.

                            THE SECRETARY:    In Senate,

                 Sunday, August 8th, the Senate met pursuant to

                 adjournment.  The Journal of Saturday,

                 August 7th, was read and approved.  On motion,

                 Senate adjourned.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    Without

                 objection, the Journal stands approved as

                 read.

                            Presentation of petitions.

                            Messages from the Assembly.

                            Messages from the Governor.

                            Reports of standing committees.



                                                        5640



                            Reports of select committees.

                            Communications and reports from

                 state officers.

                            Motions and resolutions.

                            Senator Farley.

                            SENATOR FARLEY:    Thank you, Madam

                 President.

                            On behalf of Senator Kuhl, I wish

                 to call up his bill, Print Number 6473A, which

                 was recalled from the Assembly, and it's now

                 at the desk.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    The

                 Secretary will read.

                            THE SECRETARY:    Calendar Number

                 1344, by Senator Kuhl, Senate Print 6473A, an

                 act authorizing the City of Corning.

                            SENATOR FARLEY:    Madam President,

                 I now move to reconsider the vote by which

                 this bill was passed.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    Call the

                 roll on reconsideration.

                            (The Secretary called the roll.)

                            THE SECRETARY:    Ayes, 46.

                            SENATOR FARLEY:    Madam President,

                 I now move to commit the bill to the Committee



                                                        5641



                 on Rules.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    So

                 ordered.

                            Senator Skelos.

                            SENATOR SKELOS:    Madam President,

                 there will be an immediate meeting of the

                 Rules Committee in the Majority Conference

                 Room.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:

                 Immediate meeting of the Rules Committee in

                 the Majority Conference Room.

                            SENATOR SKELOS:    And if we could

                 stand at ease pending the report of the Rules

                 Committee.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    The

                 Senate will stand at ease pending the report

                 of the Rules Committee.

                            (Whereupon, the Senate stood at

                 ease at 3:33 p.m.)

                            (Whereupon, the Senate reconvened

                 at 3:40 p.m.)

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    Senator

                 Skelos.

                            SENATOR SKELOS:    Madam President,

                 if we could return to reports of standing



                                                        5642



                 committees, I believe there's a report of the

                 Rules Committee at the desk.

                            I ask that it be read at this time.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    The

                 Secretary will read.

                            THE SECRETARY:    Senator Bruno,

                 from the Committee on Rules, reports the

                 following bills:

                            Assembly Print Number 10057A, by

                 Member of the Assembly Galef, an act to amend

                 the Transportation Law;

                            Senate Print 6824B, by Senator

                 Morahan, an act to authorize the Town of Stony

                 Point;

                            7117A, by Senator McGee, an act to

                 amend the Real Property Tax Law;

                            3277A, by Senator Robach, an act to

                 amend the Retirement and Social Security Law;

                            4347B, by Senator Sampson, an act

                 to amend Chapter 341 of the Laws of 2002;

                            6108, by Senator Maltese, an act to

                 make certain widows and children of certain

                 former uniformed employees of New York City

                 police;

                            7663B, by Senator Maziarz, an act



                                                        5643



                 to amend the Education Law;

                            7708, by Senator Skelos, an act to

                 amend the General Business Law;

                            And Senate Print 6666, by Senator

                 Rath, an act to amend Chapter 78 of the Laws

                 of 1989.

                            All bills ordered direct to third

                 reading.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    Senator

                 Skelos.

                            SENATOR SKELOS:    Move to accept

                 the report of the Rules Committee.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    All in

                 favor of accepting the report of the Rules

                 Committee will signify by saying aye.

                            (Response of "Aye.")

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    Opposed,

                 nay.

                            (No response.)

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    The

                 report is accepted.

                            Senator Skelos.

                            SENATOR SKELOS:    Madam President,

                 if we could move to the noncontroversial

                 reading of the calendar.



                                                        5644



                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    The

                 Secretary will read.

                            THE SECRETARY:    Calendar Number

                 1254, by Member of the Assembly Galef,

                 Assembly Print Number 10057A, an act to amend

                 the Transportation Law, in relation to

                 establishing.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    Read the

                 last section.

                            THE SECRETARY:    Section 2.  This

                 act shall take effect on the first of April

                 next succeeding.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    Call the

                 roll.

                            (The Secretary called the roll.)

                            THE SECRETARY:    Ayes, 54.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    The bill

                 is passed.

                            THE SECRETARY:    Calendar Number

                 1352, by Senator Morahan, Senate Print 6824B,

                 an act to authorize the Town of Stony Point to

                 finance deficits.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    There is

                 a home-rule message at the desk.

                            Read the last section.



                                                        5645



                            THE SECRETARY:    Section 8.  This

                 act shall take effect immediately.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    Call the

                 roll.

                            (The Secretary called the roll.)

                            THE SECRETARY:    Ayes, 54.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    The bill

                 is passed.

                            THE SECRETARY:    Calendar Number

                 1492, by Senator McGee, Senate Print 7117A, an

                 act to amend the Real Property Tax Law, in

                 relation to residential investment.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    Read the

                 last section.

                            THE SECRETARY:    Section 2.  This

                 act shall take effect immediately.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    Call the

                 roll.

                            (The Secretary called the roll.)

                            THE SECRETARY:    Ayes, 54.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    The bill

                 is passed.

                            THE SECRETARY:    Calendar Number

                 1579, by Senator Robach, Senate Print 3277A,

                 an act to amend the Retirement and Social



                                                        5646



                 Security Law, in relation to enhanced pension

                 benefits.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    Read the

                 last section.

                            THE SECRETARY:    Section 2.  This

                 act shall take effect immediately.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    Call the

                 roll.

                            (The Secretary called the roll.)

                            THE SECRETARY:    Ayes, 54.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    The bill

                 is passed.

                            THE SECRETARY:    In relation to

                 Calendar Number 1906, Senator Sampson moves to

                 discharge, from the Committee on Rules,

                 Assembly Bill Number 8433A and substitute it

                 for the identical Senate Bill Number 4347B,

                 Third Reading Calendar 1906.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:

                 Substitution ordered.

                            The Secretary will read.

                            THE SECRETARY:    Calendar Number

                 1906, by the Assembly Committee on Rules,

                 Assembly Print Number 8433A, an act to amend

                 Chapter 341 of the Laws of 2002.



                                                        5647



                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    There is

                 a home-rule message at the desk.

                            Read the last section.

                            THE SECRETARY:    Section 2.  This

                 act shall take effect immediately.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    Call the

                 roll.

                            (The Secretary called the roll.)

                            THE SECRETARY:    Ayes, 54.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    The bill

                 is passed.

                            THE SECRETARY:    In relation to

                 Calendar Number 1907, Senator Maltese moves to

                 discharge, from the Committee on Rules,

                 Assembly Bill Number 7174A and substitute it

                 for the identical Senate Bill Number 6108,

                 Third Reading Calendar 1907.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:

                 Substitution ordered.

                            The Secretary will read.

                            THE SECRETARY:    Calendar Number

                 1907, by Member of the Assembly Abbate,

                 Assembly Print Number 7174A, an act to make

                 certain widows and children of certain former

                 uniformed employees.



                                                        5648



                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    Read the

                 last section.

                            THE SECRETARY:    Section 2.  This

                 act shall take effect immediately.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    Call the

                 roll.

                            (The Secretary called the roll.)

                            THE SECRETARY:    Ayes, 54.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    The bill

                 is passed.

                            THE SECRETARY:    Calendar Number

                 1908, by Senator Maziarz, Senate Print 7663B,

                 an act to amend the Education Law, in relation

                 to prohibiting.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    Read the

                 last section.

                            THE SECRETARY:    Section 2.  This

                 act shall take effect on the same date and in

                 the same manner as a chapter of the Laws of

                 2004.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    Call the

                 roll.

                            (The Secretary called the roll.)

                            THE SECRETARY:    Ayes, 54.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    The bill



                                                        5649



                 is passed.

                            THE SECRETARY:    Calendar Number

                 1909, by Senator Skelos, Senate Print 7708, an

                 act to amend the General Business Law, in

                 relation to disclosure requirements.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    Read the

                 last section.

                            THE SECRETARY:    Section 3.

                 Section 1 of this act shall take effect on the

                 same date and in the same manner as a chapter

                 of the Laws of 2004.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    Call the

                 roll.

                            (The Secretary called the roll.)

                            THE SECRETARY:    Ayes, 54.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    The bill

                 is passed.

                            THE SECRETARY:    In relation to

                 Calendar Number 1911, Senator Rath moves to

                 discharge, from the Committee on Rules,

                 Assembly Bill Number 10843 and substitute it

                 for the identical Senate Bill Number 6666,

                 Third Reading Calendar 1911.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:

                 Substitution ordered.



                                                        5650



                            The Secretary will read.

                            THE SECRETARY:    Calendar Number

                 1911, by the Assembly Committee on Rules,

                 Assembly Print Number 10843, an act to amend

                 Chapter 78 of the Laws of 1989.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    Read the

                 last section.

                            THE SECRETARY:    Section 2.  This

                 act shall take effect immediately.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    Call the

                 roll.

                            (The Secretary called the roll.)

                            THE SECRETARY:    Ayes, 54.

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    The bill

                 is passed.

                            Senator Skelos, that completes the

                 noncontroversial reading of the calendar.

                            SENATOR SKELOS:    Madam President,

                 is there any housekeeping at the desk?

                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    No,

                 there is none, Senator.

                            SENATOR SKELOS:    There being no

                 further business to come before the Senate, I

                 move we stand adjourned until Tuesday,

                 August 10th, at 2:00 p.m.



                                                        5651



                            ACTING PRESIDENT McGEE:    On

                 motion, the Senate stands adjourned until

                 Tuesday, August 10th, at 2:00 p.m.

                            (Whereupon, at 3:46 p.m., the

                 Senate adjourned.)
